en: Reverse side of an exhibition announcement postcard for the Barbara Krakow Gallery. The layout is mostly white with grey vertical text on the left spelling 'BARBARA' and large grey text along the bottom reading 'KRAKOW GALLERY'. The right side contains printed information about an Annual AIDS Benefit Exhibition titled 'EVERYTHING BUT PAPER PRAYERS', including dates in December 2005, opening time, donation details, the gallery website, street address in Boston, Massachusetts, telephone number, and email address.
